detail.longDescription: RE: https:// infosec.exchange/@shadowserver /117677826184936303 Pleased to share this research I have been working on over the past few weeks into agentic AI Attack Frameworks. Data from our daily internet-wide scans and Global Honeypot Sensor Network showed: - More than 4,000 publicly exposed instances across 10+ frameworks - Over 80 IP addresses running these frameworks targeting our honeypot sensors, nearly nine in ten fingerprinted as ARTEX Gateway - Six in ten of those IP addresses attempted to relay traffic through our sensors Delighted to have led this initiative; the full analysis can be found below 👇 # ARTEX # ThreatIntelligence # AgenticAI
